title: Disrupting malicious uses of AI: October 2025
summary: Discover how OpenAI is detecting and disrupting malicious uses of AI in our October 2025 report. Learn how we’re countering misuse, enforcing policies, and protecting users from real-world harms.
body: Discover how OpenAI is detecting and disrupting malicious uses of AI in our October 2025 report. Learn how we’re countering misuse, enforcing policies, and protecting users from real-world harms.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了2025年10月份关于打击人工智能恶意使用的专项报告。报告详细阐述了官方如何检测并阻止各类利用AI进行的恶意活动、加强政策执行力度，以及在保护用户免受现实世界安全威胁方面的最新进展与成效。
